text: opus5-44 start: PDF export card (!p3). Reading context, then driving Playwright to actually print a note to PDF before writing anything.

Measured, not described. Printing a fullscreen note today: 1 A4 page, 827 chars of text, note truncated at the overlay height, 20 images, 230 KB. With a 90-line print stylesheet: 3 pages, 3590 chars, last line present, 2 images, 61 KB. Text is selectable both times (embedded fonts + ToUnicode). Also found: Ctrl+P silently switches the board to the pen tool.
